items.title: Pointed! Bloomberg’s Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
items.content: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and David Gura as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: The Entrepreneurs Behind Poppi Start Over
items.content: Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth tell Bloomberg This Weekend how they turned a farmers market business into a nearly $2 billion beverage brand and what they learned from the decade-long journey. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, the couple explains why they are starting over with Jetty, a new hydration brand, and how lessons about social media, hiring and building a team are shaping their second act. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth tell Bloomberg This Weekend how they turned a farmers market business into a nearly $2 billion beverage brand and what they learned from the decade-long journey. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, the couple explains why they are starting over with Jetty, a new hydration brand, and how lessons about social media, hiring and building a team are shaping their second act. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Poppi创始人艾莉森和斯蒂芬·埃尔斯沃斯向彭博社分享了将市集生意打造成近20亿美元饮料品牌的历程及十年经验。他们表示将推出新品牌Jetty，并分享了从社交媒体、招聘和团队建设中学到的教训，为创业第二篇章做准备。
summaries.en: Allison and Stephen Ellsworth, founders of Poppi, discuss their $2 billion beverage brand journey with Bloomberg. They share insights from their decade-long experience, focusing on lessons learned in social media, hiring, and team building. The couple is launching Jetty, a new hydration brand, and plans to apply their knowledge to this new venture. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: How China’s Intelligence Operations Target Tech
items.content: Former CIA counterintelligence analyst Peter Mattis tells Bloomberg This Weekend how China’s Ministry of State Security can use business and personal relationships to gather intelligence and potentially influence decision-making in strategically important industries. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mattis explains why technology executives can become valuable targets even without access to classified information and how AI is expanding the capabilities of Chinese intelligence operations. (Source: Bloomberg)

The insights come from a Bloomberg report.

items.title: Fed’s Collins Says ‘Steady, Gradual’ Rate Hikes Appropriate
items.content: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said a gradual path for interest-rate hikes will be appropriate to lower inflation, as the labor market gains solid footing without adding to price pressures.
items.contentSnippet: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said a gradual path for interest-rate hikes will be appropriate to lower inflation, as the labor market gains solid footing without adding to price pressures.
items.creator: Maria Eloisa Capurro

summaries.zh: 波士顿联邦储备银行行长苏珊·科林斯表示，为抑制通胀，逐步加息是合适的，因为劳动力市场已稳固，不会加剧价格压力。
summaries.en: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins stated that a "steady, gradual" approach to interest-rate hikes is suitable for lowering inflation. She noted that the labor market is stabilizing without contributing to price pressures. The gradual rate increases aim to balance inflation control with economic stability.

items.title: The Stadium Bidding War Shaking Up the Midwest
items.content: The Chicago Bears are weighing three possible homes for a new stadium: downtown Chicago, suburban Arlington Heights and Hammond, Indiana. The competition has turned into a high-stakes economic development battle involving billions of dollars in potential investment, tax incentives and public financing. Supporters say a new stadium could generate jobs, development and tax revenue, but former Indiana Governor Mitch Daniels warns that emotion can push politicians into deals that leave taxpayers paying the bill long after the ribbon cutting. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 芝加哥熊队正权衡三个新球场选址：芝加哥市中心、阿灵顿高地和印第安纳州汉密尔顿。围绕新球场的竞标已演变为一场涉及数十亿美元投资、税收优惠和公共资金的经济发展大战。支持者认为新球场能创造就业、促进发展和增加税收，但前印第安纳州州长丹尼尔斯警告称，情感可能使政客做出让纳税人长期买单的协议。(信息来源：彭博)

The bidding has sparked a high-stakes economic development competition, with potential investments, tax incentives, and public financing exceeding billions. Proponents argue the stadium would create jobs and revenue, while former Governor Mitch Daniels cautions against emotionally driven deals that burden taxpayers long-term. (Word count: 50)

items.title: SpaceX Pushes Starship Reusability to New Test
items.content: Space Network co-founder Ross Hamilton tells Bloomberg This Weekend why SpaceX’s attempt to catch Starship after its return from orbit could mark a major step toward making the rocket system fully reusable. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Hamilton explains how more frequent and less expensive launches could accelerate Starlink expansion, orbital data centers and SpaceX’s broader ambitions in space. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Space Network co-founder Ross Hamilton tells Bloomberg This Weekend why SpaceX’s attempt to catch Starship after its return from orbit could mark a major step toward making the rocket system fully reusable. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Hamilton explains how more frequent and less expensive launches could accelerate Starlink expansion, orbital data centers and SpaceX’s broader ambitions in space. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: SpaceX计划通过回收星舰火箭来提升其可重复使用性，这可能成为实现完全可重复使用的关键一步。Space Network联合创始人Ross Hamilton表示，更频繁、成本更低廉的发射将加速Starlink的扩展、轨道数据中心及SpaceX的太空野心。此观点源自Bloomberg报道。
summaries.en: SpaceX is testing Starship reusability with an attempt to catch the rocket after its orbital return, which could significantly advance its full reusability goals. Ross Hamilton, Space Network co-founder, told Bloomberg that more frequent and affordable launches enabled by Starship could boost Starlink expansion, orbital data centers, and SpaceX’s broader space ambitions. The test marks a major step toward making the system more cost-effective and versatile. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Bessent, Lutnick Clash Over Nvidia China Curbs
items.content: Axios AI policy reporter Maria Curi tells Bloomberg This Weekend about tensions inside the Trump administration over efforts to restrict the flow of advanced Nvidia chips to China and scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Megaspeed. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Curi explains the reported disagreements between Lutnick and other senior officials, including Scott Bessent, and the national security questions surrounding US technology exports to China. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Trump Heads to China for Talks With Xi and Putin
items.content: Bloomberg White House correspondent Jeff Mason tells Bloomberg This Weekend how the Trump administration responded to a nationwide FAA ground stop and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy’s push for $50 billion to modernize the US air traffic control system. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mason also looks ahead to President Donald Trump’s Asia trip and a planned meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping as technology and AI remain in focus. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: SpaceX’s S&P 500 Bid Gets New Life as Musk Pitches Tesla Merger
items.content: Just months after SpaceX was denied a swift entry into the S&P 500 Index, Elon Musk may have found a backdoor: Merging with Tesla Inc., one of the stock-market benchmark’s biggest members.
items.contentSnippet: Just months after SpaceX was denied a swift entry into the S&P 500 Index, Elon Musk may have found a backdoor: Merging with Tesla Inc., one of the stock-market benchmark’s biggest members.
items.creator: Jordan Fitzgerald and Lu Wang

summaries.zh: SpaceX因合并特斯拉可能重新进入标普500。此前其被拒入指数，现通过合并标普500最大成员之一特斯拉，或获得新途径。
summaries.en: SpaceX, recently denied a spot in the S&P 500 Index, may gain entry through a merger with Tesla, a major index member. Elon Musk is reportedly pitching this idea as an alternative route to inclusion. The move follows SpaceX's previous rejection and could provide a new pathway for the company to be considered for the benchmark index.

items.title: David Cameron Sees Hope in Alzheimer’s Research
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend, former UK Prime Minister David Cameron discusses the personal toll of losing his mother to Alzheimer’s and the accelerating search for better diagnostics, treatments and ultimately a cure. Cameron tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini about promising drug research, the potential of blood tests to transform diagnosis and why governments should move faster to support clinical trials and expand access to new treatments. Cameron’s Ending Alzheimer’s podcast launches November 16. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 前英国首相卡梅伦在彭博周末访谈中谈及母亲因阿尔茨海默症去世的个人经历，并强调对更好诊断、治疗乃至治愈方法的加速研究充满希望。他介绍了有前景的药物研究、血液检测在诊断中的潜力，并建议政府应更快支持临床试验和扩大新疗法普及。卡梅伦的《终结阿尔茨海默症》播客将于11月16日上线。（来源：彭博）

Cameron advocates for faster government support for clinical trials and expanded access to new treatments. His podcast, "Ending Alzheimer’s," launches on November 16. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Ukraine Peace Push Turns to NATO and Donbas
items.content: Bloomberg Economics defense lead Becca Wasser tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a US proposal linking NATO membership to Ukrainian concessions in the Donbas represents movement in peace talks but faces significant political and security hurdles. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Wasser also examines Ukraine’s battlefield pressures and how the US could reshape its military presence in the Middle East after the war with Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Air Travel Chaos Puts FAA Systems in Focus
items.content: Bloomberg Intelligence senior airlines analyst George Ferguson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the nationwide ground stop underscores the difficulty of modernizing an aging US air traffic control system while keeping flights moving safely. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ferguson explains why upgrading legacy technology is so complicated and how airlines face the challenge of restoring schedules after thousands of cancellations and delays. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: The nationwide air travel ground stop highlights the challenges of modernizing the aging US air traffic control system while maintaining flight safety, according to Bloomberg Intelligence analyst George Ferguson. He explains the complexities of upgrading legacy technology and the difficulties airlines face in restoring schedules after widespread cancellations and delays. The incident underscores the need for system improvements despite the risks involved.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Sees 19% Return on Asia ex-Japan Stocks in 2027
items.content: Goldman Sachs expects earnings growth to drive a 19% return for the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index in dollar terms next year, even as it warned that uncertainty over artificial intelligence could fuel volatility.
items.contentSnippet: Goldman Sachs expects earnings growth to drive a 19% return for the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index in dollar terms next year, even as it warned that uncertainty over artificial intelligence could fuel volatility.
items.creator: Echo Wong

summaries.zh: 高盛预计，2027年MSCI亚洲（除日本）指数将以19%的回报率上涨，主要受盈利增长驱动。但该行也警告，人工智能的不确定性可能加剧市场波动。
summaries.en: Goldman Sachs forecasts a 19% return on the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index in 2027, driven by earnings growth. However, the firm warns that uncertainty surrounding artificial intelligence may increase market volatility. The projection is based on current market trends and expected economic performance.
